description: This Java class 'VersionChecker' handles version verification for the rusEfi project. It fetches version information from a specified URL, compares recommended versions against current ones, displays update warnings, and alerts about critical issues. It is part of the maintenance UI for the console application.

classes.name: VersionChecker
classes.description: A singleton class that checks and compares software and firmware versions, prompts user warnings, and fetches version info from a remote URL.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new thread to read version info from a remote server.

methods.name: readAndProcess
methods.description: Reads version data from a specified URL, updates internal mappings, and shows warnings if needed.

methods.name: parseNotNull
methods.description: Parses a string to an integer with error handling, throwing exception if null.

methods.name: showUpdateWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays a warning dialog if a new version is available and the user has not suppressed warnings.

methods.name: getPaneParent
methods.description: Returns the parent component for dialogs (main JFrame).

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of VersionChecker.

methods.name: onFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Processes a firmware version string and shows update warning if applicable.
